title: Evaluate Completed App
template: Act as a senior software architect. Evaluate this completed application: [paste app code/details]. Assess: overall functionality and user experience. Identify performance bottlenecks and scalability potential. Check for security vulnerabilities and code quality issues. Evaluate maintainability. Provide detailed feedback with prioritized improvement recommendations and implementation suggestions.

title: Clean Up Code
description: Remove redundancies, format properly, and suggest improvements
template: Act as a code style expert. Clean up this [language] code for better readability and efficiency: [paste code here]. Focus on: removing unused imports/variables. Improving naming conventions. Fixing formatting and indentation. Eliminating redundancies. Adding comments where needed. Preserve all functionality. Output: cleaned code in a code block, followed by suggestions for further improvements.

title: Debug Code
description: Find and fix issues with step-by-step reasoning
template: Act as a senior debugger. Debug this [language] code: [paste code here]. It's not working as expected—[describe symptom, e.g., 'throws error X' or 'returns wrong value']. Provide step-by-step reasoning: reproduce the issue. Analyze inputs and logic flow. Identify root causes (e.g., null checks, async issues). Suggest targeted fixes with explanations. Output: fixed code in a code block, plus preventive measures.

title: Explain Code
description: Break down code step by step with analysis
template: Act as a code educator. Explain this [language] code step by step: [paste code here]. Break down: what each part does and why. Highlight key logic flow, inputs/outputs, and potential issues. Use simple analogies where helpful. Output in Markdown: ## Overview, ## Line-by-Line Breakdown, ## Key Insights, ## Potential Improvements.

title: Add Specific Feature
template: Act as a feature engineer. Add [describe feature, e.g., user authentication] to this existing [language] code: [paste code here]. Integrate it seamlessly and handle any dependencies. Ensure: backward compatibility, error handling, and edge cases. Output: updated code in a code block, plus explanation of changes and testing suggestions.

title: Generate Tests
template: Act as a QA engineer. Write unit tests for this [language] function/code: [paste code here]. Cover: happy paths, edge cases, error conditions, and performance benchmarks. Use [framework, e.g., Jest]. Aim for 80%+ coverage. Output: test code in a code block, plus run instructions and expected outcomes.

title: Optimize Code
description: Improve performance, memory usage, or speed
template: Act as a performance optimizer. Optimize this [language] code for [aspect, e.g., speed/memory/CPU usage]: [paste code here]. Focus on: algorithmic improvements, memory management, reducing complexity, and eliminating bottlenecks. Provide before/after performance comparisons if possible. Output: optimized code in a code block, with explanations.

title: Document Features
template: Act as a technical writer. Add detailed documentation to this code or feature: [paste code or describe feature]. Include: comments explaining each section, inputs/outputs, usage examples, and API references. Use Markdown for clarity. Output: documented code/version, plus a separate README-style summary.

title: Refactor with Changes
template: Act as a refactoring specialist. Refactor this [language] code with these changes: [list changes, e.g., make asynchronous, optimize loops]: [paste code here]. Maintain original behavior. Focus on: modular design, readability, and testability. Output: refactored code in a code block, diff highlights, and rationale.

title: Security Audit
template: Act as a security expert. Perform a security audit on this [language] code: [paste code here]. Identify vulnerabilities like [specific concerns, e.g., SQL injection, XSS]. Suggest fixes. Output in Markdown: ## Vulnerabilities Found, ## Risk Levels, ## Fixed Code, ## Prevention Tips.

title: API Development
template: Act as a backend developer. Create a RESTful API for [resource] in [language/framework]. Include: CRUD operations, input validation, error handling, rate limiting, and OpenAPI documentation. Handle authentication if needed. Output: full code in a code block, deployment instructions, and test endpoints.

title: Repair Code
description: Fix bugs and explain the changes made
template: Act as a code repair specialist. Repair this broken [language] code: [paste code here]. It's producing [describe error or issue]. Fix the bugs and explain the changes. Output: repaired code in a code block, step-by-step explanation of fixes, and unit tests to verify.

title: Generate New Code
description: Create new scripts or applications from scratch
template: Act as a code generator. Generate a [language] script/application that [full description, e.g., fetches weather data and displays in CLI]. Include: error handling, modularity, and comments. Use best practices. Output: complete code in a code block, usage instructions, and potential extensions.

title: Code Review Analysis
template: Act as a code reviewer. Perform a comprehensive review of [paste code]. Focus on: maintainability, performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and best practices. Provide actionable recommendations. Output in Markdown: ## Strengths, ## Issues (prioritized), ## Recommendations, ## Overall Score.

title: Testing Strategy
description: Create comprehensive testing strategies and plans
template: Act as a test strategist. Generate a testing strategy for [application/feature]. Include: unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, performance benchmarks, and automation setup. Specify tools [e.g., Jest, Cypress]. Output: detailed plan in Markdown, sample test code, and coverage goals.

title: Create Full App Prototype
template: Act as a full-stack developer. Build a simple [app type, e.g., task manager] prototype in [stack, e.g., React + Node]. Include: UI, backend, database integration, authentication. Focus on core functionality. Output: project structure, key files in code blocks, setup/run instructions, and limitations.

title: System Architecture Design
template: Act as a system architect. Design a scalable architecture for [app type] with [requirements, e.g., high traffic]. Include: service boundaries, API contracts, data flow diagrams, deployment strategy. Use [tools, e.g., microservices]. Output: detailed design in Markdown with diagrams (text-based), trade-offs, and scalability notes.

title: Database Schema Design
template: Act as a database designer. Design a normalized database schema for [application] in [DB type, e.g., PostgreSQL]. Include: tables, relationships, indexes, constraints, and queries. Consider performance and scalability. Output: SQL schema in a code block, ER diagram (text), and optimization rationale.

title: Performance Profiling
template: Act as a profiler. Profile this [language] code for [metric, e.g., speed]: [paste code here]. Identify bottlenecks. Suggest improvements like algorithmic changes or caching. Provide benchmarking code. Output: analysis in Markdown, optimized code, before/after metrics.

title: CI/CD Pipeline
template: Act as a DevOps engineer. Generate a CI/CD pipeline for [tech stack] using [tool, e.g., GitHub Actions]. Include: build, test, deploy stages, security scanning, and rollback. Output: YAML/config file in a code block, setup instructions, and monitoring suggestions.

title: Technical Debt Analysis
template: Act as a debt analyst. Analyze this codebase for technical debt: [describe or paste relevant code]. Identify: code smells, duplication, complexity. Prioritize by impact/effort. Output in Markdown: ## Debt Items (table: Issue, Impact, Effort), ## Refactoring Plan, ## Business Justification.

title: Convert Code Languages
template: Act as a code translator. Convert this [source language] code to [target language]: [paste code here]. Preserve functionality, idioms, and performance. Handle language-specific differences. Output: translated code in a code block, mapping explanations, and any caveats.

title: Migration Guide
description: Migrate code between frameworks, libraries, or versions
template: Act as a migration expert. Help migrate this [current tech/library] code to [target tech/library]: [paste code here]. Include: breaking changes to handle, new patterns to adopt, testing strategy, and rollback plan. Output: step-by-step guide in Markdown, migrated code snippets.

title: Configuration Issues
template: Act as a config troubleshooter. Debug this configuration issue: [describe problem]. Config files: [paste relevant configs]. Environment: [describe setup]. Identify root cause and provide solution. Output: fixed configs in code blocks, explanation, and verification steps.

title: Deployment Issues
template: Act as a deployment specialist. Fix this deployment issue: [describe problem]. Environment: [dev/staging/prod]. Logs: [paste relevant logs]. Config: [paste config]. Provide root cause and fix. Output: updated deployment script/config, step-by-step resolution, and monitoring tips.

title: Concurrency Analysis
template: Act as a concurrency expert. Review this [language] code for concurrency issues: [paste code here]. Check: race conditions, deadlocks, thread safety. Suggest synchronization patterns. Output: analysis in Markdown, fixed code, and testing strategies for concurrency.

title: Code Documentation
template: Act as a documentation engineer. Generate comprehensive docs for [code/project]: [paste code or describe]. Include: API references, usage examples, architecture diagrams (text), troubleshooting guides. Use Markdown. Output: full docs structure, with code snippets integrated.

title: Document API Endpoint
template: Act as an API documenter. Document this API endpoint: [paste code or describe]. Include: request/response formats, error handling, and example calls. Use OpenAPI/Swagger style. Output: Markdown docs with JSON examples, authentication notes, and rate limits.

title: Clean Up with Style Guide
description: Follow specific coding standards and style guides
template: Act as a style enforcer. Clean up this [language] code to follow [style guide, e.g., PEP 8]: [paste code here]. Focus on: indentation, variable naming, and removing unused imports. Output: cleaned code in a code block, linting report, and any deviations explained.

title: Refactor for Scalability
template: Act as a scalability engineer. Refactor this [language] code for scalability [changes, e.g., add caching, parallel processing]: [paste code here]. Test for performance gains. Output: refactored code, scalability analysis, benchmarking results, and deployment considerations.

title: Rapid Prototyping
template: Act as a prototyper. Build a working prototype of [feature] using [tech stack]. Focus on: core functionality, minimal viable product. Include basic UI if applicable. Output: code files in blocks, run instructions, and iteration suggestions.

title: Repair Runtime Issues
description: Fix crashing code with stack trace analysis
template: Act as a runtime fixer. Repair this [language] code crashing at runtime: [paste code here]. Stack trace: [paste trace]. Analyze and fix cause. Output: repaired code, explanation of root cause, and runtime tests to verify stability.

title: Explain with Comparison
description: Compare code approaches and their trade-offs
template: Act as a code comparator. Explain this [language] code and compare to [alternative approach]: [paste code here]. Highlight: pros/cons, performance, maintainability. Output in Markdown: ## Current Approach, ## Alternative, ## Comparison Table, ## Recommendation.

title: Add Feature with Library
description: Add features using specific libraries or frameworks
template: Act as a library integrator. Add [feature, e.g., email notifications] using [library, e.g., SendGrid] to this [language] code: [paste code here]. Ensure: security, testability. Output: integrated code, setup instructions, and usage examples.

title: Remove References
description: Remove libraries, variables, or deprecated elements
template: Act as a cleanup specialist. Remove all references to [specify what to remove, e.g., a library or variable] from this [language] code: [paste code here]. Replace with alternatives if needed to keep it functional. Output: cleaned code, changes summary.

title: Remove Deprecated Elements
description: Update deprecated code to modern equivalents
template: Act as a modernization expert. Remove deprecated [element, e.g., API calls] from this [language] code and update to modern equivalents: [paste code here]. Output: updated code, migration notes, and compatibility checks.

title: Edge Case Testing
description: Identify and test edge cases thoroughly
template: Act as an edge case tester. Analyze this [language] function/code for edge cases: [paste code here]. Identify: boundary conditions, error inputs, unusual scenarios. Write tests. Output: test cases in code block, coverage report, and handling suggestions.

title: Code Review Feedback
description: Provide constructive feedback on code changes
template: Act as a peer reviewer. Review this code change/diff: [paste code or diff]. Provide constructive feedback on: code quality, potential bugs, performance implications, security concerns, and best practices. Suggest specific improvements. Output: structured feedback in Markdown.
